title: 24.5 A 72GS/s 9b Time-Interleaved Pipeline-SAR ADC Achieving 55.3/49.3dB SFDR at 20GHz/Nyquist Inputs in 16nm FinFET
problem: Time-interleaved (TI) ADCs for optical receivers (>100Gb/s) require near-100GS/s sampling with high SFDR (>55dB) at wideband (>20GHz) inputs. Massive TI factors degrade SFDR due to bandwidth mismatch and implicit distortion in the interleaver; sampling-capacitor tuning addresses only first-order correction; high-frequency input buffers introduce distortion and gain attenuation.
motivation: Optical communication scaling beyond 100Gb/s with advanced modulations demands ADCs with exceptional SFDR performance at high input frequencies while maintaining energy efficiency.
method: The chip combines 64 parallel converter units (each running at 1.125 gigasamples per second at different times) to achieve 72 gigasamples per second through time interleaving. Each unit uses a pipeline-SAR architecture (a hybrid of two conversion methods that balances signal accuracy with conversion speed), equipped with linearized input buffers to handle 20GHz signals without distortion, dual-path bootstrapped switches for consistent performance, and a simple resistor-based amplifier. These design choices eliminate the complex calibration between stages that conventionally limits time-interleaved converters at high frequencies.
key_novelty: The core innovation is a time-interleaved pipeline-SAR architecture using linearized input buffers and bootstrapped switches that achieves 55dB signal-to-distortion ratio at 20GHz wideband inputs without inter-stage gain calibration.
contributions: 55.3dB SFDR at 20GHz input, 49.3dB at Nyquist (22.5GHz) in 72GS/s TI configuration
Linearized wideband input buffers minimizing distortion and gain attenuation
Dual-path bootstrapped switch design for improved linearity
R/R-based open-loop amplifier eliminating inter-stage gain calibration
baselines: Prior TI ADCs with timing-skew calibration only
limitations: Not discussed; noise figure, temperature stability, and jitter sensitivity over extended operation not characterized.
primary_theme: TI pipeline-SAR ADC for high-SFDR optical receivers
